Davidson Investment Advisors Position in United Technologies (UTX) Has Lifted by $1.14 Million; Botty Investors Holding in Apple (AAPL) Has Lowered as Stock Value Rose
June 10, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Davidson Investment Advisors increased its stake in United Technologies Corp (UTX) by 9.81% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davidson Investment Advisors bought 9,132 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.23% with the market. The institutional investor held 102,202 shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.86M, up from 93,070 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davidson Investment Advisors who had been investing in United Technologies Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $102.10B market cap company. The stock increased 0.02% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $127.61. About 2.76 million shares traded. United Technologies Corporation (NYSE:UTX) has risen 3.91% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.66% the S&P500.
